roles.description: I lead the team behind ChatLLM's core agentic platform: the layer that decides which model and workflow each request should go to, and gives agents the tools to do real work like writing documents and editing code. Along the way I've taken a couple of ideas from zero to launch, including a health companion that connects to your wearables and an AI character chat product. Mostly I like finding what people are already trying to do and building the thing that does it well.

First engineer at an early-stage startup bringing AI to manufacturing sales. Built the workflows that turn messy documents and images into ready-to-send quotes, and the tooling to check how well the models were actually doing.
